name: force-bed-mesh
title: Force Bed Mesh
description: Forces a full bed mesh calibration before every print, even when the Snapmaker app would skip it, so the first layer sticks reliably on a freshly leveled bed. Pick this OR Force Adaptive Bed Mesh, not both. Snapmaker U1 only.
tagline: Always run a full bed mesh before each print.
author: bespoked
attributions:
# Attributions - force-bed-mesh

**Plugin author:** paxx12 (Extended Firmware overlay `36-feature-print-preferences`), packaged by Bespok3d

Forces a full bed mesh before every print.

| Upstream project | Author | Licence | Needed at runtime | Code ships in this package |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Extended Firmware overlay `36-feature-print-preferences` | paxx12 | GPL-3.0 | no | yes |

The Klipper config in this package is the `bed_leveling_force.cfg` tweak from the Extended Firmware overlay
`36-feature-print-preferences` (paxx12), GPL-3.0. It ships here with the same macro, the
same `rename_existing` name and the same body; only the file name and the layout differ.
